entries.target: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Scorch your target with putrefying flames. Applies Black Flames to your target, a 6 second fast DoT. Black Flames are consumed by your other damaging skills to deal double damage and apply Cremate, reducing DoT Resistance by 10% for 10 seconds, stacks to 10.
entries.evidence: Flame of Maleno Rank Needed: 1 Mana Cost: 10 Mana Cooldown: 2.5 Seconds Type: Magical Range: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 1 target. Description: Scorch your target with putrefying flames. Applies Black Flames to your target, a 6 second fast DoT. Black Flames are consumed by your other damaging skills to deal double damage and apply Cremate, reducing DoT Resistance by 10% for 10 seconds, stacks to 10. Fuel The Flame: Applies Decay to your target for 5 seconds. Also applies Decomposing Flames for 20 seconds, increasing Black Flames' stack limit to 3 and causing skills that consume it to deal 150% more damage for each additional stack. Note: Deals 40% magical damage.
